# VMBridge

> VMBridge is a macOS app for Parallels Desktop. It is an MCP server that gives an AI agent a virtual machine: screen, keyboard, mouse, commands, files, and snapshots. The price is $9.99 USD once, with a 7-day full-featured free trial. Governing law is the State of Connecticut, United States. Parallels is a registered trademark of Parallels International GmbH. VMBridge is not affiliated with or endorsed by Parallels.

The command is `vmbridge`. `parallels-pro-mcp` and `guest-vm-agents` are aliases. Default site: https://vmbridge.app. Alternative host: https://vmbridge.pages.dev. X: @vmbridgeapp.

## Pages
- [VMBridge for Parallels Desktop: let your AI agent drive VMs](https://vmbridge.app/): Let your AI agent drive Parallels Desktop VMs. VMBridge is an MCP server for macOS 14 or later. $9.99 one-time, with a 7-day full-featured free trial. Works with Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.
- [MCP server for Parallels Desktop](https://vmbridge.app/mcp-server-for-parallels-desktop/): VMBridge is an MCP server for Parallels Desktop. Agents see the VM screen, type, click, run commands, and move files without touching the Mac desktop.
- [Claude Code control a VM](https://vmbridge.app/claude-code-control-a-vm/): Use Claude Code to control a Parallels Desktop VM with VMBridge. One command connects the agent. The VM's screen, keyboard, and mouse stay inside the guest.
- [AI agent virtual machine on Mac](https://vmbridge.app/ai-agent-virtual-machine-mac/): Give an AI agent a virtual machine on a Mac. VMBridge runs on macOS and drives Parallels Desktop guests: Linux, Windows, and macOS, with per-VM permissions.
- [VMBridge comparison](https://vmbridge.app/comparison/): How VMBridge compares with dedicated agent VM tools. VMBridge connects an AI agent to Parallels Desktop over MCP.
- [VMBridge pricing](https://vmbridge.app/pricing/): VMBridge is a $9.99 one-time purchase for macOS, with a 7-day full-featured free trial. It is not a subscription. A license key is checked with Polar.
- [VMBridge FAQ](https://vmbridge.app/faq/): Answers about VMBridge for Parallels Desktop: the MCP server, the $9.99 license, the 7-day trial, Claude Code, the DMG, privacy, and feature comparison.
- [VMBridge docs](https://vmbridge.app/docs/): Install VMBridge, connect an MCP agent, and read the trial rules. The same pages are plain Markdown for people and for answer engines.
- [VMBridge privacy policy](https://vmbridge.app/privacy/): What VMBridge stores on the Mac, and what a license check sends to Polar. No analytics SDK is included.
- [VMBridge end user license](https://vmbridge.app/eula/): VMBridge is sold by Chadwick Labs. Polar Software, Inc. is the merchant of record. Support is support@vmbridge.app.
- [VMBridge trademark notice](https://vmbridge.app/trademark/): Parallels is a registered trademark of Parallels International GmbH. VMBridge is not affiliated with or endorsed by Parallels.
